description.en: Scan Java/Maven projects for compiler warnings, style issues, and bugs, auto-fix safely, verify, and submit as PR
description.de: Java/Maven-Projekte auf Compiler-Warnungen, Style-Issues und Bugs scannen, sicher auto-fixen, verifizieren und als PR einreichen

instructions:
Du bist ein automatischer Java-Code-Fixer. Deine Aufgabe ist es, Findings aus statischer Analyse sicher zu beheben.

SICHERHEITSREGELN:
- IMMER auf eigenem Branch arbeiten, nie auf main
- Ein Commit pro Fix (atomar, reviewbar, revertierbar)
- Keine Breaking Changes an oeffentlichen APIs
- Keine Dateien loeschen die noch referenziert werden
- Bei Unsicherheit: Fix ueberspringen statt riskieren
- Build und Tests muessen nach allen Fixes bestehen

JAVA-SPEZIFISCH:
- Lombok-Annotationen beachten (@Data, @Builder, etc. generieren Methoden)
- MapStruct-Mapper nicht manuell aendern (werden generiert)
- Spring-Annotationen (@Service, @Repository, etc.) nicht entfernen
- Bei Generics: Diamond-Operator nutzen wo moeglich (Java 7+)
- Raw Types nur fixen wenn der Typ eindeutig ableitbar ist
- @SuppressWarnings nur als letztes Mittel
- Flyway-Migrationen NIEMALS aendern

COMMIT-KONVENTIONEN:
- fix: <beschreibung>
- refactor: <beschreibung>
- style: <beschreibung> — fuer Formatting
- chore: <beschreibung> — fuer Dependency-Updates

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
REPO_URL="{{ repo_url }}"
BASE_BRANCH="{{ base_branch }}"
SOURCE_DIR="{{ source_dir }}"
if [ -z "$BASE_BRANCH" ] || [ "$BASE_BRANCH" = "{{ base_branch }}" ]; then BASE_BRANCH="main"; fi
if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] || [ "$SOURCE_DIR" = "{{ source_dir }}" ]; then SOURCE_DIR="src/"; fi

echo '=== Git Safety Check ==='
if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'ERROR: Not a git repository!' && exit 1
fi

if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo 'ERROR: Working tree is dirty! Commit or stash changes first.'
  git status --short
  exit 1
fi

git checkout "$BASE_BRANCH" && git pull --ff-only origin "$BASE_BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || true

BASE_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
FIX_BRANCH="fix/java-autofix-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"

echo "=== Creating branch: $FIX_BRANCH ==="
git checkout -b "$FIX_BRANCH"

echo "BASE_COMMIT=$BASE_COMMIT"
echo "BASE_BRANCH=$BASE_BRANCH"
echo "FIX_BRANCH=$FIX_BRANCH"
echo "SOURCE_DIR=$SOURCE_DIR"
echo 'Git setup complete. Ready for scanning.'

set -uo pipefail
SOURCE_DIR="{{ source_dir }}"
if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] || [ "$SOURCE_DIR" = "{{ source_dir }}" ]; then SOURCE_DIR="src/"; fi

# Find pom.xml directory
POM_DIR="."
if [ -f "$SOURCE_DIR/../pom.xml" ]; then
  POM_DIR=$(cd "$SOURCE_DIR/.." && pwd)
elif [ -f "pom.xml" ]; then
  POM_DIR="."
fi

echo '=== Java Code Scan ==='
cd "$POM_DIR"

echo ''
echo '--- Maven Compile (Warnings) ---'
mvn compile -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(WARNING|warning|deprecated|unchecked|rawtypes)' | head -50 || echo 'No compiler warnings found'

echo ''
echo '--- Maven Compile (Verbose for deprecation/unchecked) ---'
mvn compile -Xlint:all 2>&1 | grep -E '(warning:|Note:)' | head -50 || echo 'No additional warnings'

echo ''
echo '--- Checkstyle (if plugin configured) ---'
if grep -q 'maven-checkstyle-plugin' pom.xml 2>/dev/null; then
  mvn checkstyle:check 2>&1 | tail -30 || true
else
  echo 'Checkstyle plugin not configured in pom.xml'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- PMD (if plugin configured) ---'
if grep -q 'maven-pmd-plugin' pom.xml 2>/dev/null; then
  mvn pmd:check 2>&1 | tail -30 || true
else
  echo 'PMD plugin not configured in pom.xml'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- SpotBugs (if plugin configured) ---'
if grep -q 'spotbugs-maven-plugin' pom.xml 2>/dev/null; then
  mvn spotbugs:check 2>&1 | tail -30 || true
else
  echo 'SpotBugs plugin not configured in pom.xml'
fi

echo ''
echo '--- Unused Imports / Dead Code (basic grep) ---'
echo 'Scanning for common issues...'
find "$SOURCE_DIR" -name '*.java' -exec grep -l 'import .*\*;' {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -20 && echo '(wildcard imports found)' || echo 'No wildcard imports'
find "$SOURCE_DIR" -name '*.java' -exec grep -ln '@SuppressWarnings' {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo 'No @SuppressWarnings found'

echo ''
echo '--- Dependency Check ---'
mvn dependency:tree -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(WARNING|CONFLICT)' | head -20 || echo 'No dependency conflicts'

echo ''
echo '=== Scan Complete ==='

Analysiere die Scan-Ergebnisse und erstelle einen strukturierten Fix-Plan.

SCAN-ERGEBNISSE:
{{ previous_output }}

DOMAIN-KONTEXT:
{{ domain_context }}

AUFGABE:
1. Extrahiere alle Findings aus Compiler-Warnings, Checkstyle, PMD, SpotBugs und Dependency-Check
2. Klassifiziere jedes Finding:

   AUTO_FIXABLE (sicher automatisch behebbar):
   - Unused imports (entfernen)
   - Wildcard imports (durch spezifische Imports ersetzen)
   - Missing @Override Annotation
   - Raw types → Diamond operator / explizite Generics
   - Unnecessary casts
   - Missing serial version UID (wenn Serializable)
   - Deprecated API Aufrufe (wenn Replacement klar ist)
   - Checkstyle-Formatting (Einrueckung, Leerzeichen, Klammern)
   - Unnoetige @SuppressWarnings entfernen
   - String-Vergleich mit == statt .equals()
   - Leere catch-Bloecke (mindestens Logger hinzufuegen)

   MANUAL_REVIEW (zu komplex/riskant):
   - API-Signatur-Aenderungen
   - Architektur-Refactorings
   - Dependency-Version-Updates (koennen Inkompatibilitaeten verursachen)
   - Komplexe Logik-Aenderungen
   - Lombok/MapStruct-Generierungsprobleme
   - Flyway-Migrationen

   INFORMATIONAL:
   - Hinweise ohne konkreten Fix

3. Sortiere AUTO_FIXABLE: Imports → Annotations → Types → Code-Fixes
4. Gib den Fix-Plan aus:

FIX_PLAN:
1. [AUTO_FIXABLE] <Datei>:<Zeile> — <Issue> — <Was zu tun ist>
2. ...

SKIPPED (MANUAL_REVIEW):
- <Datei>: <Grund>

SKIPPED (INFORMATIONAL):
- <Beschreibung>

Falls keine Findings: FIX_PLAN: EMPTY - Keine fixbaren Findings gefunden.

config.goal:
Arbeite den Fix-Plan aus dem vorherigen Schritt ab und committe jeden Fix einzeln.

FIX-PLAN:
{{ previous_output }}

REGELN:
1. Nur [AUTO_FIXABLE] Eintraege abarbeiten
2. Falls FIX_PLAN EMPTY: 'NO_FIXES_NEEDED' ausgeben und beenden
3. Ein Commit pro Fix — atomare Git-History
4. Commit-Format: 'fix: <was behoben>' / 'style: <formatting>' / 'refactor: <was refactored>'
5. SICHERHEIT:
   - Keine API-Signaturen aendern (public/protected Methoden)
   - Keine Dateien loeschen die noch importiert werden — pruefe Imports
   - Lombok: @Data/@Builder/@AllArgsConstructor generieren Methoden — nicht duplizieren
   - MapStruct: Mapper-Interfaces nicht manuell aendern
   - Flyway: Migrations-Dateien (V*.sql) NIEMALS aendern
   - Spring: @Autowired/@Service/@Repository nicht entfernen
   - Bei Unsicherheit: Fix ueberspringen als SKIPPED
6. WICHTIG: Jede ACTION wird von einem SEPARATEN Agenten ausgefuehrt.
   Jede ACTION MUSS enthalten:
   - ABSOLUTE Dateipfade
   - Vollstaendigen Kontext was zu aendern ist
   - Nach der Aenderung: git add <datei> && git commit -m '<message>'

AUSGABE am Ende:
FIXES_APPLIED:
1. <Datei> — <Commit-Hash> — <Beschreibung>

FIXES_SKIPPED:
- <Datei> — <Grund>

TOTAL: X Fixes applied, Y skipped
config.success_criteria: Alle AUTO_FIXABLE Issues wurden als einzelne Commits committed oder begruendet uebersprungen.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
SOURCE_DIR="{{ source_dir }}"
VERIFY_CMD="{{ verify_command }}"
if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] || [ "$SOURCE_DIR" = "{{ source_dir }}" ]; then SOURCE_DIR="src/"; fi

echo '=== Verification ==='

if echo '{{ previous_output }}' | grep -q 'NO_FIXES_NEEDED'; then
  echo 'VERIFICATION_PASSED (no fixes to verify)'
  exit 0
fi

# Custom verify command
if [ -n "$VERIFY_CMD" ] && [ "$VERIFY_CMD" != "{{ verify_command }}" ]; then
  echo "Running custom verification: $VERIFY_CMD"
  if eval "$VERIFY_CMD"; then
    echo 'VERIFICATION_PASSED'
  else
    echo 'VERIFICATION_FAILED'
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# Find pom.xml directory
POM_DIR="."
if [ -f "$SOURCE_DIR/../pom.xml" ]; then
  POM_DIR=$(cd "$SOURCE_DIR/.." && pwd)
fi

cd "$POM_DIR"
PASSED=true

echo '--- mvn clean test ---'
if ! mvn clean test -q 2>&1 | tail -30; then
  PASSED=false
fi

# Re-check for compiler warnings
echo '--- Compiler warnings check ---'
WARN_COUNT=$(mvn compile 2>&1 | grep -c 'WARNING\|warning' || echo 0)
echo "Remaining compiler warnings: $WARN_COUNT"

# Checkstyle re-check if available
if grep -q 'maven-checkstyle-plugin' pom.xml 2>/dev/null; then
  echo '--- Checkstyle re-check ---'
  mvn checkstyle:check 2>&1 | tail -10 || true
fi

# Dependency tree check
echo '--- Dependency tree check ---'
mvn dependency:tree -q 2>&1 | grep -E '(WARNING|CONFLICT)' | head -5 || echo 'No dependency conflicts'

if [ "$PASSED" = "true" ]; then
  echo 'VERIFICATION_PASSED'
else
  echo 'VERIFICATION_FAILED'
fi

config.else_command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== Verification failed — attempting rollback ==='
BASE_BRANCH="{{ base_branch }}"
if [ -z "$BASE_BRANCH" ] || [ "$BASE_BRANCH" = "{{ base_branch }}" ]; then BASE_BRANCH="main"; fi

SOURCE_DIR="{{ source_dir }}"
if [ -z "$SOURCE_DIR" ] || [ "$SOURCE_DIR" = "{{ source_dir }}" ]; then SOURCE_DIR="src/"; fi
POM_DIR="."
if [ -f "$SOURCE_DIR/../pom.xml" ]; then
  POM_DIR=$(cd "$SOURCE_DIR/.." && pwd)
fi

MAX_REVERTS=5
REVERTED=0
while [ $REVERTED -lt $MAX_REVERTS ]; do
  if [ $(git rev-list --count ${BASE_BRANCH}..HEAD) -le 0 ]; then break; fi
  echo "Reverting commit: $(git log -1 --oneline)"
  git revert HEAD --no-edit
  REVERTED=$((REVERTED + 1))
  RETEST_OK=true
  cd "$POM_DIR"
  mvn clean test -q 2>&1 | tail -5 || RETEST_OK=false
  cd - >/dev/null
  if [ "$RETEST_OK" = "true" ]; then
    echo "Verification passed after reverting $REVERTED commit(s)."
    echo "PARTIAL_FIX: Reverted $REVERTED breaking commit(s). Remaining commits are safe."
    break
  fi
done
if [ "$RETEST_OK" != "true" ]; then
  echo "PARTIAL_FIX: Reverted $REVERTED commits but verification still fails. Manual review needed."
fi
echo ''
echo '=== Remaining commits ==='
git log --oneline | head -20
config.then_command: echo 'All checks passed. Ready for PR.'

config.question:
## Java Auto-Fix Ergebnis

{{ previous_output }}

### Optionen:
- **Yes**: Push + Pull Request erstellen
- **No**: Branch lokal behalten fuer manuelle Review
- **Abort**: Branch loeschen und zurueck zu main

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
DECISION="{{ pr_decision }}"
BASE_BRANCH="{{ base_branch }}"
if [ -z "$BASE_BRANCH" ] || [ "$BASE_BRANCH" = "{{ base_branch }}" ]; then BASE_BRANCH="main"; fi
FIX_BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)

echo "Decision: $DECISION"
echo "Branch: $FIX_BRANCH"

case "$DECISION" in
  Yes|yes)
    COMMIT_COUNT=$(git rev-list --count ${BASE_BRANCH}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    if [ "$COMMIT_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo 'No commits to push. Nothing to do.'
      exit 0
    fi
    echo "=== Pushing $COMMIT_COUNT commits ==="
    git push -u origin "$FIX_BRANCH"
    
    FIXES=$(git log --oneline ${BASE_BRANCH}..HEAD | sed 's/^/- /')
    
    PR_TITLE="fix(java): Auto-fix compiler warnings and style issues"
    PR_BODY="## Summary\n\nAutomated Java code fixes from static analysis.\n\n## Changes\n\n$FIXES\n\n## Verification\n\nmvn clean test passed after applying fixes.\n\n---\n_Generated by MySuricates Auto-Fix Java Pipeline_"
    
    echo "=== Creating Pull Request ==="
    PR_URL=$(gh pr create --base "$BASE_BRANCH" --title "$PR_TITLE" --body "$(echo -e "$PR_BODY")" 2>&1)
    echo "PR created: $PR_URL"
    ;;
  No|no)
    echo "Branch '$FIX_BRANCH' kept locally."
    echo "To review: git checkout $FIX_BRANCH"
    echo "To push later: git push -u origin $FIX_BRANCH"
    ;;
  Abort|abort)
    echo '=== Aborting — cleaning up ==='
    git checkout "$BASE_BRANCH"
    git branch -D "$FIX_BRANCH"
    echo "Branch $FIX_BRANCH deleted. Back on $BASE_BRANCH."
    ;;
  *)
    echo "Unknown decision: $DECISION. Branch kept locally."
    ;;
esac
